selection: Every distinct compatible block with at least two covers in the frozen 326-address discrimination census. No selection by rank or by success of arithmetic computations.
method: Certify potential pair-mask span from all common projective roots at primes through97; retain actual odd-pair product-point witnesses when available. Separately factor every pair resultant in each block with one bounded worker and a checkpoint per completed pair. Exact support size requires all pair factorizations to complete.
failure_semantics: Timeout preserves completed factors and leaves full support UNKNOWN. Potential collision masks are not asserted locally soluble; actual witnesses give only a lower bound on realizable span unless they attain the parity upper bound. Prime97 is a fixed diagnostic cutoff, not a full-support claim.
